correctness.rationale: Identified vector space K[R5] with K[X]/(X^5-1)=K[t]/(t^5), where t=log X and quandle multiplication is U(-t)V(2t), using truncated exponential valid in char 5. The commutator coefficients are (3d01,3d02,4(d03+d12),-d13) for 2x4 minors. Every six-minor array satisfying the Plücker relation decomposes over every field. Eliminating d23 and splitting on d01 yields the discriminant b3²-2b2b4 square iff decomposable. Nonzero linear coefficient always works, so any augmentation vector is one or at most two; nonsquare witnesses prove sharpness. Direct independent exhaustive 5^8 effective ordered pairs over F5 gave 585 single values and 40 exceptions; q=25 formula yields 7200. These checks support, not replace, arbitrary-field proof.
